SELECT p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.sector_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: Move player and active ship to Stardock

data.sql: WITH moved_player AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{stardock_sector_id} WHERE player_id = @{planet_tester_1_player_id} RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{stardock_sector_id} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM moved_player);

tests.name: Rig: Dock the active ship at Stardock shipyard

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ported = (SELECT p.port_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE p.sector_id = @{stardock_sector_id} AND pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1) WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{planet_tester_1_player_id});
